notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste that is a 1/1 Balloon in addition to its other types.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters the battlefield, each Coercive Recruiter you control triggers.
Resolve the first two triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve all other Coercive Recruiter triggers, if applicable.
Repeat.
